# Poe2RuleContext

[API index](../index)

Values armed by the native rule engine for the current predicate/action invocation.

## SinceLastActivation

```typescript
SinceLastActivation(minTime: number): boolean;
```

True after more than minTime seconds since this rule's action last completed successfully.
A returned Promise completes when fulfilled; rejection does not reset this clock.
Uses script tick time. Before any successful completion, or outside a rule, returns true.
